method: ASR word-anchor mapping to known script; unmatched spans and within-word character times interpolated; not forced/phoneme alignment.

quality.qualityScope: Timing-estimation diagnostics; does not confirm that every supplied script word was spoken.

numberDiagnostics.limit: ASR errors, number formatting and paraphrases can trigger flags. A flag is not a confirmed omission.

numberPhrases.expectedPhrase: hai mươi hai nghìn bốn trăm bốn mươi

numberDiagnostics.expectedFinalSentence: Lúc ấy khách có được chờ bánh rẻ lại không?
numberDiagnostics.lexicalLimits: Number checks search the chapter, not the corresponding speech location. A match cannot prove every number was spoken in its intended order; a missing phrase can be an ASR mistake. Final-sentence normalization can also fail on harmless recognition differences. This is not prosody assessment.

boundaryInstruction: Use acoustic matched word times for exact phrase cues. Interpolated start/end/number spans require inspection; do not claim forced alignment.
